**Period 1: Foundational Knowledge**

| 1 | EDX1007 | Introduction to Project Management | edx | This course provides a solid foundation in project management principles, including communication skills and an understanding of why today's projects are more complex. |

This course is a good starting point as it covers the basics of project management, including communication skills and an understanding of why today's projects are more complex. It provides a solid foundation for the learner to build upon.

**Period 2: Project Life Cycle and Stakeholders**

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

**Period 3: Agile Principles and Practices**
| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

**Period 4: Advanced Project Management**
| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |

**Learning Path for Public Health and Epidemiology Basics**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU5729 | Foundations of Public Health Practice Specialization | Coursera | Foundational knowledge of public health principles and concepts |
| 2 | COU3468 | Foundations of Public Health Practice: The Public Health Approach | Coursera | Introduction to the public health approach and preventive measures |
| 3 | COU3400 | Population Health: Fundamentals of Population Health Management | Coursera | Understanding of population health management and its principles |
| 4 | COU3773 | Epidemiology: The Basic Science of Public Health | Coursera | Introduction to epidemiology and its role in public health |
| 5 | COU4578 | Epidemiology in Public Health Practice Specialization | Coursera | Practical application of epidemiology in public health practice |
| 6 | COU5018 | Investigating Epidemics like COVID-19: An Analyst's Guide | Coursera | Advanced epidemiology and data analysis skills for investigating epidemics |
| 7 | COU2224 | Foundations of Public Health Practice: Health Protection | Coursera | Understanding of health protection and its role in public health |
| 8 | COU3404 | Data and Health Indicators in Public Health Practice | Coursera | Introduction to data analysis and health indicators in public health |
| 9 | COU3818 | Health Systems Development: Health systems, Policy and Research | Coursera | Understanding of health systems development and policy research |
| 10 | COU6090 | The People, Power, and Pride of Public Health | Coursera | Practical application of public health principles and concepts in real-world scenarios |

The learning path starts with foundational knowledge of public health principles and concepts in Period 1, introducing learners to the basics of public health and epidemiology. Period 2 builds on this foundation by introducing the public health approach and preventive measures. Period 3 delves deeper into population health management, its principles, and applications. Period 4 introduces epidemiology and its role in public health, while Period 5 applies epidemiology in public health practice. Period 6 advances epidemiology and data analysis skills for investigating epidemics. Period 7 and 8 focus on health protection and data analysis, respectively. Period 9 and 10 cover health systems development and policy research, and practical application of public health principles and concepts in real-world scenarios. This learning path provides a comprehensive understanding of public health and epidemiology basics for a non-clinician learner.
